source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 233 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 233.

PD 233.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 233 was established by Ordinance No. 19250, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 6, 1986. Ordinance No. 19250 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 19250 was amended by Ordinance No. 21227, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 11, 1992. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19250; 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 233 is established on property generally located at the southeast corner of Dallas Parkway and Bent Tree Forest Drive. The size of PD 233 is approximately 7.762 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19250; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Conceptual Site Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.104. CONCEPTUAL SITE PLAN.

A conceptual site plan, approved by the city plan commission, is labelled Exhibit 233A. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Land Use Plans
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.105. LAND USE PLANS.

(a) Dallas Parkway Center Study. The Dallas Parkway Center Study is a land use study that was adopted by the city council on June 26, 1985, which addresses, among other things, problems of density and transportation in an area bounded by L.B.J. Freeway (I.H. 635), the Dallas North Tollway, Belt Line Road, and Montfort Road. A copy of the adopted study is on file in the department of development services.

(b) Expansion study. A study expanding the Dallas Parkway Center Study to an area called “The Dallas Parkway Center Extension,” which includes the Property and makes specific reference to improvements required for the management of traffic generated by the Property and other surrounding tracts, is labelled Exhibit 233B. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711; 26457)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.106. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

A development plan for each phase of development must be submitted to and approved by the commission prior to issuance of a building permit for development within that phase. Each development plan must be accompanied by a landscape plan which must also be approved prior to the issuance of a

building permit in the area covered by that development plan. All development must be in accordance with the approved development and landscape plans. All landscaping shown on a particular landscape plan must be installed within six months of the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any use with the area covered by the plan. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.107. PERMITTED USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are those nonresidential uses permitted in an SC Shopping Center District and a hotel. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Building Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.108. BUILDING SETBACKS.

Minimum building setbacks are as shown on the conceptual site plan. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.109. COVERAGE.

Maximum permitted coverage, including aboveground parking structures, for any lot on the Property, is 60 percent. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.110. FLOOR AREA.

Maximum permitted floor area for all uses on the Property combined is 591,697 square feet. Maximum permitted floor area for all retail and bar and restaurant uses combined is 20,000 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Heights
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.111. MAXIMUM HEIGHTS.

Maximum permitted height for any structure is 210 feet. All building heights over 163 feet must be approved by the Federal Aviation Administration as not hazardous to air navigation prior to the issuance of a building permit. Maximum permitted height for any parking structure is seven levels, with no more than 10 feet between floors. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.112. OFF-STREET PARKING.

(a) Phased office parking limit. In order to promote the development of transportation alternatives, the maximum number of parking spaces for office uses on the Property is restricted in accordance with the regulations below. In order to permit adequate parking for initial phases of development, the restrictions are phased in to gradually reduce the ratio of parking spaces to office floor area from 3.0 spaces for each 1,000 square feet, when building permits have been issued for construction of more than 338,113 square feet of office use, to 2.38 for each 1,000 square feet, when building permits have been issued for construction of more than 439,547 square feet of office use. For the purposes of this phased office parking limit, “office use” includes medical clinics, banks and savings and loan offices, and all office uses.

(b) Maximum number of spaces for office uses. Maximum number of parking spaces for office use is 3.0 spaces per 1,000 square feet until building permits have been issued for construction of 338,113 square feet of office use. When building permits have been issued for construction of more than

338,113 square feet of office use, but less than 439,547 square feet, maximum number of parking spaces is 2.5 spaces per 1,000 square feet of office use. Maximum number of parking spaces for office use when building permits have been issued for construction of more than 439,547 square feet of office use is 2.38 spaces per 1,000 square feet. No more than 1,408 parking spaces for office uses are permitted on the Property.

(c) Minimum office parking. Minimum permissible number of parking spaces provided for office use at any stage of development is 2.0 spaces per 1,000 square feet.

(d) Requirements for other uses. All uses other than office must supply parking in compliance with the minimum requirements of the Dallas Development Code, however, no off-street parking may be supplied in excess of the code requirements. The provisions of Section 51-4.301(c)(6) (the mixed use parking reduction bonus) do not act to restrict the maximum number of spaces permitted, but may be used to calculate the minimum number of spaces permitted. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Road Improvements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.113. ROAD IMPROVEMENTS.

(a) In general. The owner(s) must dedicate all right-of-way and complete the improvements that are listed in Subsections (b), (c), and (d) below prior to the issuance of a building permit or within 90 days of notice from the director of public works and transportation that the city is preparing to begin paving operations, whichever comes first. All improvements must be in accordance with specifications approved by the director of the department of public works and transportation.

(b) Northbound Dallas North Tollway frontage road. The owner(s) shall dedicate 10 feet of right-of-way and must construct a right turn lane at Bent Tree Forest Drive with 150 feet of storage and 100 feet of transition.

(c) Knoll Trail Drive. Knoll Trail Drive is currently designated as a six lane divided minor arterial within 90 feet of right-of-way.

(1) The owner(s) shall dedicate sufficient right-of-way to provide 45 feet of right-of- way from the center line.

(2) The owner(s) must provide sufficient right-of-way and construct adequate (in the opinion of the director of the department of public works and transportation) deceleration lanes at driveway entrances on Knoll Trail Drive.

(3) The timing of construction for the Knoll Trail Drive improvements will be determined by the director of public works and transportation.

(d) Bent Tree Forest Drive. The owner shall dedicate an additional two feet of right-of-way along Bent Tree Forest Drive. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.114. ACCESS.

Curb cuts for vehicular ingress-egress are limited to the number and approximate locations as shown on the conceptual site plan. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.115. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII, “Sign Regulations.” No non-premise signs are permitted. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Transportation System Management
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.116. TRANSPORTATION SYSTEM MANAGEMENT.

(a) General. The owner(s) shall establish and operate a TSM program to encourage carpool, vanpool, and other transportation alternatives. A specific TSM action program must be submitted to the city plan commission concurrent with the submission of the first detailed development plan in which office use greater than 338,113 square feet is proposed. An annual report must be furnished to the director of public works and transportation.

(b) Reports. The first annual report must be submitted within two years after the issuance of the first certificate of occupancy for office use on the Property that exceeds 338,113 square feet and must be submitted annually thereafter until being directed otherwise by the director of public works and transportation. The final report must be submitted two years after the issuance of the certificate of occupancy which would permit occupancy of 90 percent of the final building shown on the detailed development plan(s).

(c) Alternative. In lieu of the requirements in Subsection (a), the owner(s) may participate in and fund on a pro rata basis with other local area property owners, an area-wide Transportation Management Organization (TMO) that is approved by the city. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.117. PAVING.

(a) All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must comply with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19250; 21227; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.118. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Development of the Property must comply with the requirements of all applicable federal and state laws and regulations and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21227; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.119. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19250; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-233.120. ZONING MAP.

PD 233 is located on Zoning Map No. B-7. (Ord. Nos. 19250; 25711)
